jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
As a physician-founded and led organization, ensuring everyone has access to quality healthcare is what inspires us. The magic we’ve created lies in Carbon Health’s custom EHR and the collaboration among clinical teams, engineers, and designers who work side-by-side to deliver innovation like our hands free AI charting tool. That’s why we hire people who genuinely care about patients, solving healthcare challenges, and making a positive impact every day. Join us and help change the future of healthcare for the better.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable services that real clinical workflows depend on. You'll design and own backend systems, APIs, and the event-driven infrastructure that connects them.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can take a service from technical design to production, make pragmatic decisions, and collaborate effectively with product and engineering teams.

You'll work with modern JVM technologies, AWS, and event-driven systems in a healthcare technology environment where reliability, data integrity, and delivery matter.

**What you'll do**

* Design, build, and own JVM backend services (Java, Kotlin, or Scala) from technical design through production.
* Build reliable service-to-service communication with gRPC: well-defined contracts, deadlines and timeouts, retries with backoff, idempotent operations, and graceful degradation when a dependency fails.
* Design public and internal APIs (REST, GraphQL)
* Build event-driven and asynchronous workflows that stay consistent under failure, using patterns such as idempotent consumers, dead-letter handling, Saga, and Transactional Outbox.
* Own the infrastructure your services run on: define and evolve it with Terraform, review infrastructure changes like application code, and ship through automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Make services observable with metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, and alerting tied to service-level objectives.
* Model data and tune queries in relational databases so performance stays predictable as data grows.
* Handle sensitive healthcare data responsibly through access control, encryption, and audit trails.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code, lead technical design discussions, and help raise the bar through reviews and mentoring.
* Use AI effectively to improve development workflows, from exploration and implementation to testing, debugging, and documentation.
* Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to deliver features on time.

**Qualifications**

* Strong professional experience building and operating backend systems in production.
* Solid experience with the JVM ecosystem: Java, Kotlin, or Scala.
* Hands-on experience with gRPC or a similar RPC framework for service-to-service communication, including timeouts, retries, and failure handling.
* Experience designing production-grade APIs with REST and GraphQL.
* Experience with event-driven architecture and message queues, and with the delivery and consistency challenges that come with them.
* Solid relational database experience: schema design, indexing, and query performance.
* Hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with Terraform.
* Experience running services in production: observability, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic approach to engineering decisions.
* Ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Professional working proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
* A strong interest in using AI efficiently and responsibly in software development.  
    
  **Nice to have**

* Experience in healthcare technology or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience with healthcare data standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
* Experience with resilience patterns such as circuit breakers, bulkheads, and rate limiting.
* Experience with stream processing or change data capture.
* Experience with containers and container orchestration.
* Some frontend familiarity to collaborate smoothly across the stack.
* Experience contributing to technical architecture and mentoring other engineers.

**What we offer**

* Remote-first, full-time, permanent employment in Türkiye.
* Salary paid in USD, net.
* Payroll employment with the benefits of a permanent position.
* Access to our office at ODTÜ Teknokent, Ankara, with regular visits according to planned schedules.
* 100% private health insurance coverage for the employee.
* 50% private health insurance coverage for eligible family members, if you choose to include them.
* Floating vacation days: when a public holiday falls on a weekend, you can take the corresponding day off on a weekday of your choice, subject to applicable policies.
* The opportunity to work on meaningful healthcare technology products with a collaborative engineering team.
* A culture that values ownership, continuous learning, and delivering high-quality software.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain industrial applications and services using C#/.NET, Angular, MSSQL, Redis, NATS, and related technologies.
* Own solutions end-to-end, from requirement gathering and architecture through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and troubleshooting while remaining responsible for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of the solution.
* Develop backend services, APIs, and machine-data integrations using technologies such as MQTT, NATS, OPC-UA, and Kepware.
* Design and optimize databases, queries, stored procedures, caching strategies, and production data flows.
* Build real-time dashboards, reporting, and monitoring solutions for production KPIs and operational data.
* Design reliable systems that handle production realities such as high data volumes, concurrency, connectivity issues, duplicate messages, and out-of-order events.
* Troubleshoot issues across frontend, backend, database, messaging, infrastructure, and machine integration layers.
* Work directly with operators, engineers, and production teams to understand requirements, validate solutions, and improve existing systems.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, CI/CD, automated testing, and production diagnostics.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development and operational processes using software and AI.
* Travel abroad when required for business needs, including project implementation, technical support, collaboration.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably involving production systems, manufacturing, MES, industrial automation, or machine integration.
* Strong C#/.NET skills, including ASP.NET Core, APIs, asynchronous programming, and background services.
* Strong Angular and TypeScript development skills.
* Strong MSSQL knowledge, including database design, indexing, query optimization, and stored procedures.
* Understanding of distributed systems, messaging, caching, concurrency, and event-driven architectures.
* Experience with technologies such as NATS, MQTT, OPC-UA, Kepware, or similar industrial integration platforms.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools.
* Ability to review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and architectural fit.
* Understanding of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, logging, and production troubleshooting.
* Strong problem-solving skills across software, database, integration, and manufacturing environments.
* Ability to communicate effectively with software teams, controls engineers, process engineers, operators, and business stakeholders.

* This is an **on-site position** at our Izmir Plant in the **Aegean Free Zone (ESBAS), Izmir, Türkiye**. **Remote or hybrid working is not available.**

***Come join our global, inclusive & diverse team***

Our purpose is to improve the quality of life of everyone we touch through our innovative motion systems. We are a truly global team bound together by our shared values. Our culture is built on the diversity, knowledge, skills, creativity, and talents that each employee brings to the company. Our people are our company’s most valuable asset. We are committed to providing an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace where employees of different backgrounds feel valued and respected, regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity or religious background. We are committed to inspiring our employees to grow, act with ownership and find fulfilment and meaning in the work they do.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Trainee aan boord
jobs.description:
Over je werkomgeving

Stap aan boord van een van onze nieuwste, ultramoderne schepen en ontdek een wereld op zich. Waar een divers team van stuurmannen, deckhands en scheepskoks tot ingenieurs en elektrotechnici elke dag samenwerkt. Ieder met zijn eigen expertise, maar met één gedeelde drijfveer: samen bouwen aan de wereld van morgen. Samen installeren jullie infrastructuur voor hernieuwbare energie, maken jullie transport over water mogelijk, beschermen jullie onze kusten en bouwen jullie de meest geavanceerde havens. En dat allemaal met de meest geavanceerde vloot en moderne apparatuur.

En binnen dat team zorg jij, samen met je collega’s van de technische crew, ervoor dat alle elektrische systemen aan boord blijven draaien zoals het hoort. Van onderhoud en troubleshooting tot software-optimalisatie: jullie zorgen ervoor dat alles blijft werken.

Wat houdt de rol in

Onze schepen worden steeds slimmer, complexer en geavanceerder. En dus hebben we elektrotechnici nodig die mee zijn met hun tijd. Net afgestudeerd in Elektromechanica of Toegepaste Informatica? Perfect. Jij brengt de nieuwste kennis mee, wij zorgen voor de ervaring, de begeleiding en hypermoderne apparatuur om mee aan de slag te gaan. Jouw rol:

* Je bent mee met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen elektromechanica. Nieuwe technologie? Bring it on.
* Je krijgt energie van techniek waarbij je zowel je handen als je hersenen aan het werk zet.
* Elektrische systemen? Daar weet jij raad mee: van onderhoud en storingen opsporen tot testen, meten en herstellen.
* Je leest vlot elektrische schema’s en technische plannen en weet hoe je elektrische installaties, motoren, generatoren en schakelkasten aanpakt. Geen probleem als je dat nog niet allemaal beheerst: als starter krijg je de ruimte om volop bij te leren en ervaring op te bouwen.
* Automatisatie, PLC’s, netwerken en digitale systemen? Daar wil je meer van weten. Met HMI’s (Human-Machine Interface) krijg je een inkijk in wat er aan boord gebeurt: je navigeert door de systemen, analyseert wat er misgaat en vindt sneller de oorzaak én de oplossing.
* Je denkt graag mee over hoe systemen slimmer, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder kunnen werken.
* Veilig werken staat altijd voorop. Je hebt aandacht voor veilige werkprocedures, lockout/tagout en de juiste manier van werken aan elektrische installaties.

Klinkt als een serieuze boterham?

Dat is het ook. Maar gelukkig hoef je dat niet allemaal alleen te doen. Ons team aan boord gaat samen met jou aan de slag, geeft je kansen om te leren en te groeien en staat altijd voor je klaar wanneer je even wilt ventileren.

Kan je niet wachten om ons te ontmoeten? Maak dan alvast even kennis met onze collega’s Simon en Christof.

**Wat heb je nodig?**

* Een (professionele) bachelor of HBO Bachelor in Elektromechanica, Toegepaste Informatica of Scheepswerktuigkunde ETO
* Vlot in het Engels. Dat is nu eenmaal de voertaal aan boord.
* Een eerste werkervaring is niet nodig.
* Organisatieskills, stressbestendigheid, proactieve houding.
* Geen zeevaartschool of vaarbevoegdheid op zak? Geen probleem. Die heb je voor deze functie niet nodig.

Wat mag je verwachten

* Een boeiende en afwisselende job in een no-nonsense internationale werkomgeving.
* Werken op één van onze bagger- en offshore schepen (rotatiesysteem: 6 weken werken / 6 weken verlof).
* De winnende combinatie tot succesvolle projecten: teamspirit en autonomie.
* Blijvende kansen tot persoonlijke groei.
* Een fijne werkomgeving: van sportfaciliteiten en lekker, gezond eten tot een nette en comfortabele leefomgeving met alles wat je nodig hebt om je thuis te voelen aan boord.

Wij zoeken het schip dat bij je past. We breiden onze vloot steeds uit met high-tech schepen die van alle markten thuis zijn. Zowel op grote als kleinere schepen is er plaats op dek of in de machinekamer.

Je komt er terecht in een team van Can-Do mensen. Zij delen graag hun ervaring met jou en helpen je ‘on-the-job’ met het leren kennen van zowel schip als projecten. Daarnaast krijg je een doorgedreven en continue opleiding via onze JDN Academy.

**De wereld is wat jij ervan maakt**

Jan De Nul geeft wereldwijd vorm aan water en land. We drijven de transitie naar hernieuwbare energie met offshore energie-infrastructuur. We focussen op natuur-inclusieve baggeroplossingen om havens te bouwen en onze kustlijn te beschermen. We ontwikkelen innovatieve bouwprojecten voor slimme mobiliteit en duurzame gebouwen. En we herontwikkelen onze planeet door vervuilde sites een nieuwe bestemming te geven. Bij Jan De Nul is de wereld wat jij ervan maakt.

*Jan De Nul stimuleert diversiteit en inclusie op de werkplek. We zijn een werkgever voor gelijke kansen en tegen discriminatie.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Solutions Engineer for Marketing New
jobs.description:
Ghent, Belgium

  

**Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?**

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

**Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light**

We are **Lumineers**. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

* **Pursuit of greatness**: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
* **Meaningful work matters**: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

**Job Details**

* Marketing
* Belgium
* Full-Time/Hybrid

**What you will do**

You will join as a **Senior AI Solutions Engineer for Marketing**, focused on transforming our internal operations. You will be at the forefront of using AI to solve complex business problems, optimize workflows with AI agents, design and build integrations for business scalability. This is a future-proof role where you will build innovative solutions and have a direct impact on how our business operates as a key part of a new, decentralized team of AI specialists.

**Where you will have impact**

* Design and implement AI solutions that solve real-world business problems within our Marketing teams.
* Collaborate directly with domain experts to deeply understand business challenges, workflows, and opportunities for automation and improvement.
* Design, build, and operate AI agent workflows and integrations to optimize our marketing operations for scalability.
* Act as a key member of the broader cross-functional AI engineering team, sharing knowledge, best practices, and successful patterns.
* Work closely with our central AI infrastructure engineers to build robust and scalable solutions.
* Pitch your own ideas and co-create the roadmap for AI adoption within your domain, helping us build the perfect solutions.
* Drive projects with a solution-oriented and outcome-focused mindset, ensuring technology delivers tangible business value.

**About our team**

Lighthouse Marketing is a global team of creative thinkers who blend the art and science of marketing to amplify the brand, drive revenue, and deliver great marketing experiences. We work across time-zones, we focus on the metrics that matter, and we push each other to continually raise the bar. We embrace a customer-first approach to marketing and continually look for points of friction in the funnel that marketing can help to solve. We are on the lookout for new growth levers, we encourage experimentation, and we embrace a culture of learning and growth.

**What's in it for you?**

* Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
* Career development: Workshops, frameworks, and trainings to maximize your professional potential.
* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Mobility options: Mobility budget or company car (based on your job category).
* Net allowance: Support for home office related expenses.
* Vouchers: Lunch vouchers & Eco vouchers.
* Comprehensive health insurance: Extensive coverage for you and your dependents.
* Pension funding: Group insurance to secure your future.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* A strong background in Software Engineering and Integration Engineering.
* Hands-on experience experimenting with various AI tools and building out new, AI-driven workflows in production.
* Proven business understanding and experience working in a business-facing role.
* A solution-oriented and outcome-driven mindset, focused on solving problems rather than just pure engineering craftsmanship.
* A hands-on and curious nature, with an interest in learning and understanding complex business processes.
* Fluent communication in English.

### **We welcome**

* Familiarity with Marketing technology - Salesforce, Hubspot or similar tools.
* Experience building on top of LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, Gemini) in a production context.
* Experience with data platforms such as BigQuery or similar.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!
